groups.title: Google TV setup wizard: with launcherx disabled its RecoveryActivity (HOME priority 1) outranks set-home-activity. Disable it only after Home resolves to the new launcher, and re-enable it before a factory reset. It can own the Wi-Fi network saved during first setup, and disabling it deletes the networks it owns: check `dumpsys wifi | grep -o 'cname=[^ ]*'` first. On this set (on Wi-Fi) the network read cname=android.uid.system, so it stayed; if it reads setupwraith, forget and re-join the network in Settings first. On Google TV, casting is reported to stop without it; this set was not used for casting.
